verdict.rationale: Poly documents a CLI (`poly` with 25+ commands) and a hosted MCP server (https://mcp.poly.app/mcp with OAuth) that let AI agents and assistants drive file search, read, write, and organization programmatically, confirmed by both docs and a live runtime probe. However, there is no conventional public REST/OpenAPI API — probes for openapi.json/swagger.json all returned 404 — so agentic access is limited to MCP/CLI surfaces rather than a general-purpose documented API. missing for 10: a REST/OpenAPI-documented API, independent third-party corroboration of API usage beyond vendor docs.
